import parse

# R1: Test letters matcher
try:
    p = parse.compile('{name:l}')
    print('R1 PASS: letters type accepted')
except ValueError as e:
    print(f'R1 FAIL: {e}')

# R2: Test __contains__
r = parse.parse('{a} {b}', 'hello world')
print(f'R2 fixed: {hasattr(r, \"__contains__\")}')
r2 = parse.parse('{a:x} {b:w}', 'hello world')
print(f'R2 named: {hasattr(r2, \"__contains__\")}')
print(f'R2 contains check: {\"hello\" in r if hasattr(r, \"__contains__\") else \"N/A\"}')

# R3: Test malformed braces
try:
    p = parse.compile('{hello')
    print(f'R3 FAIL: no error raised for {{hello')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'R3 PASS: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')

# R7: Test findall case_sensitive
results = parse.findall('{}', 'HELLO hello HELLO', case_sensitive=False)
print(f'R7 default (case_insensitive): {[r.fixed[0] for r in results]}')
results_cs = parse.findall('{}', 'HELLO hello HELLO', case_sensitive=True)
print(f'R7 case_sensitive: {[r.fixed[0] for r in results_cs]}')

# R9: Test slice access
r = parse.parse('{} {} {}', 'a b c')
try:
    s = r[0:2]
    print(f'R9 slice: {s}, type={type(s)}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'R9 FAIL: {e}')
"
